fail_closed_conditions: negative / bool / float / NaN / inf / str token count -> InvalidUnitError/InvalidRequestError
usage AVAILABLE without any known field -> InvalidRequestError
usage AVAILABLE while provider not invoked -> InvalidRequestError
provider_usage supplied while availability is UNAVAILABLE -> InvalidRequestError
duplicate attempt_id with conflicting content -> InvalidRequestError (idempotent replay must be byte-identical)
aggregation over divergent minimization run fingerprints -> InvalidRequestError

LogicalRequestTokenSummary.note: context savings counted once per logical request; unknown usage keeps complete=False

total_provenance.attempts_reporting_total: count of known attempts that carried an explicit provider total
total_provenance.derived_total_tokens: sum of derived input+output; cached/cache_write/reasoning excluded (never re-added)
total_provenance.provider_reported_total_tokens: sum of ONLY explicit provider-reported totals; never a derived value
total_provenance.rule: a field named 'provider ... total' contains ONLY provider-reported values; provider-reported and derived totals are never blended into one field
total_provenance.settlement_token_units: documented settlement selection per attempt (reported total if present, else derived); meaningful only when complete

ProviderTokenUsage.derived_total: input+output ONLY (cached/cache_write/reasoning excluded to avoid double-count); reported total_tokens preserved separately

principle: Context Minimization measures how much context was safely removed (A). The request estimate measures the complete serialized request (B) via an INJECTED counter — the core implements no provider tokenizer. Provider usage measures what the API reported consuming (C); it is authoritative for the response being reconciled, never overwrites the estimate, and is NOT an invoice. Unknown usage is None, never zero.

tenant_isolation.attempt_id_binding: the tenant namespace is a prefix-free segment of the derived attempt id, so identical tenant-local ids in different tenants derive different attempt ids

explicit_retry_reference.enforcement: reconcile_api_call_measurement fails closed with InvalidRequestError if retry_of.tenant_namespace != canonical_tenant_namespace(prepared.attribution.tenant_id), BEFORE any record is built or written to a sink; the current tenant is never silently substituted
explicit_retry_reference.rule: explicit retry linkage is a tenant-scoped reference, never a raw opaque string (N3)
explicit_retry_reference.scope: tenant-scope validation only; it does NOT assert the referenced parent record exists (durable referential-integrity is deferred)
explicit_retry_reference.serialization: the parent's tenant namespace equals the record's own (enforced), so retry lineage inherits an unambiguous namespace; retry_of_attempt_id + attribution.tenant_id are both bound in record_fingerprint

tenant_isolation.fingerprint: tenant_id is bound into ApiCallTokenRecord.record_fingerprint via attribution
tenant_isolation.named_tenant_namespace: tenant_id present -> 't:' + tenant (must be non-empty, non-whitespace)
tenant_isolation.single_tenant_namespace: tenant_id is None -> 's' (domain-separated; NEVER an empty string)
tenant_isolation.sink_idempotency_key: (tenant_namespace, attempt_id) — two tenants may store the same explicit attempt_id; same-tenant replay is idempotent; same-tenant conflict is rejected; tenant isolation does not rely on record fingerprints
